videos.title: Christmas Special (2021)
videos.overview: Julspecial was the first Christmas special of Bäst i Test, airing on SVT on 25 December 2021. The special featured Anis Don Demina, Marcus Berggren, Sofia Dalén, and Sussie Eriksson as contestants, and was won by Sofia Dalén.

videos.title: Christmas Special (2022)
videos.overview: Julspecial was the second aired Christmas special of Bäst i Test, airing on SVT on 26 December 2022. The special featured Henrik Nyblom, Linnéa Wikblad, Marko Lehtosalo, and Nikki Amini as contestants, and was won by Marko Lehtosalo.

videos.title: Worst in Test
videos.overview: A single episode special of Bäst i Test, pitting five previous season losers against one another to determine who was the worst of them all, aired on the 24th of May 2024. The cast featured: Marika Carlsson (season 2 loser), Nassim Al Fakir (season 3 loser), Kristina 'Keyyo' Petrushina (season 4 loser), Johanna Nordström (season 5 loser), and Marcus Berggren (season 6 loser). In this special episode, the contestants must get a banana into a bucket, try to break a world record, form a choir, make the most unique choices, get the highest paintball score, get a family member to hang up on them, and order tea from David before their toast finishes.

videos.title: Christmas Special (2024)
videos.overview: Julspecial (Christmas Special) was the third Christmas special of Bäst i Test, airing on TV4 on 20 December 2024. The special featured Hanna Dorsin, Klas Eriksson, Pär Lernström, Samir Badran, and Sissela Benn as contestants, and was won by Klas Eriksson.

videos.title: Champion of Champions
videos.overview: An extra-long single-episode Champion of Champions special aired on the 21st of March 2025, featuring Bianca Kronlöf (season 1 champion), Erik Ekstrand (season 2 champion), Clara Henry (season 3 champion), Olof Wretling (season 5 champion), and Linnéa Wikblad (season 7 champion) [the winners of seasons 4 and 6 were actually the guest contestants, collectively, so that wouldn't have worked very easily]. In this special, the champions must eat twice as many marshmallows as the contestant who eats the fewest, help their future selves build a tower, break a dozen eggs from as far away as possible, complete all of the tasks on the roof, make two bookcases identical, and balance items on a small table.

videos.title: Christmas Special (2025)
videos.overview: Julspecial (Christmas Special) is the fourth Christmas special of Bäst i Test, airing on TV4 on 25 December 2025. The special features Marcus Aujalay, Molly Nutley, Peter Settman, Rik Haag, and Tina Nordström as contestants.

videos.title: Chance for Redemption
videos.overview: The time has come for five former participants to get another chance to show what they are made of.

videos.title: Kalle Wahlström-Zackari
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must bring in the most unusual item, pop some bubble wrap, figure out what David has in his pocket, find out about an Icelandic person, empty a bathtub, make a bed while holding hands, make a dairy-based horror movie trailer, and memorise the names of some bearded men.

videos.title: Eva Röse
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must bring in the most valuable item, place some exercise balls on top of a hill, paint a horse while riding a horse, identify some Finns, resist the urge to blink, work in teams to move a potato, bring in a photo of an object that looks like themselves, and keep the lowest unique number of doughnuts on a stick.

videos.title: Parisa Amiri
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must bring in the trendiest item of clothing, do something that will look impressive in reverse, score 11 points, throw paper clips into a glass, impress a 104-year-old, buy a gift for the Taskmaster, and separate the yellow sweets while wearing boxing gloves. Also, Claes gets to count some ravioli.

videos.title: Marko Markoolio Lehtosalo
videos.overview: In this season finale, the contestants must bring in the best dinner party guest, move a boulder as far as possible, borrow 100 kronor from a high-income earner, build a tower using Finnish sticks, get a train to honk its horn, stage a realistic home movie blooper, and stand up after exactly 100 seconds. Also, four of the contestants get to write their own tasks, while the fifth contestant has to guess who wrote each of them.

videos.title: Claes Malmberg
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must bring in the most regrettable souvenir, eat an ice lolly, fell some ducks, answer questions while their team-mate is building a tower, draw the median Buddha, get the tent and its contents through a tunnel, beautifully destroy a cake, and make the longest balloon chain.

videos.title: Clara Henry
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must bring in the least used garment, throw a teabag into a mug, paint a portrait of the Taskmaster without touching a red mat, move water from one bucket to another, identify some Henrys, find out a stranger's profession, choreograph a dance to a ringtone, and pop on a onesie inside a tent.

videos.title: Ann Westin
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must bring in the most boastful item, slice bread using something from the shed, slide as far as possible, build the tallest cardboard box tower, cut a string to the contestants' combined height, get as much flour onto a target as possible, make a meal for an Icelander, pour 235ml of raspberry juice, and make the longest continuous noise.

videos.title: Emma Knyckare
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must bring in the most interesting sound, open a jar of mayonnaise, keep a basketball on a treadmill, guide their team-mates through an obstacle course, select the lowest unique number of pasta pieces, make a block of ice disappear, drop an egg as far as possible without it breaking, throw something into something else, and play word table tennis. In an exciting tie-breaker, two contestants compete to see who can eats the most of a lemon in one minute.

videos.title: Al Pitcher
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must bring in the best moose-related item, create the highest splash, propel a pea along a red carpet, record a video for a children's song, draw an upside-down bicycle, conceal a pineapple on their person, hit a ball as far as possible, and make the most fruit juice.

videos.title: Nisse Hallberg
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must bring in the most unnecessary battery-powered thing, arrive on time, burst all of the balloons, create and eat an exotic sandwich, memorise a code, fill a cylinder with water, draw a portrait of someone they cannot see, and pack a suitcase. In a thrilling tie-breaker, two contestants compete in decanting some påskmust.

videos.title: Moa Lundqvist
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must bring in the hippest headwear, put an egg in an eggcup, squirt ketchup on a roll of paper, persuade three dogs to stand on the mat, lift a collection of items with one hand, resist laughing, camouflage themselves, and play musical words.

videos.title: Thomas Petersson
videos.overview: In this season finale, the contestants must bring in the most cash, gain the most weight, get a potato into a hole, spread their possessions far and wide, knock over a plastic bottle, get a bun to David in the fewest steps, give David a surprise, and stand up after exactly 100 seconds.

videos.title: Per Andersson
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must invent a new profanity, find out what's in a toolbox, return to the house wearing a hat, perform the best wheelbarrow stunt, make a coconut-flinging machine, play spot the difference, and zipwire items to the Taskmaster. Also, Per Andersson gets set a special task involving a long wait, and the others have to guess how long he'll last.

videos.title: Emma Molin
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must make the biggest bubble and burst it with their nose, do something manly with a cardboard box, make an amazing stop-motion movie, hide a coconut inside a box, stick plasters to the correct body parts, get an old friend to ring a bell, build a boat for David, get the highest darts score, and play a game of 'Babben says'. In an exciting tie-breaker, two contestants compete to make the tallest lemon tower.

videos.title: Måns Nathanaelson
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must put the largest thing inside a balloon, travel as far as possible without touching the ground, vote for who should receive five points, score 11 points, shake hands with the Taskmaster without revealing their identity, get the most balls into a goal, put a melon in a toilet, place some rubber ducks in a bathtub, and write down the second longest word starting with 'T'.

videos.title: Fab Freddie
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must prevent a rocket from firing, declare their love for the Taskmaster, keep David dry, bake the largest cinnamon bun, identify the contestants' relatives, unravel a reel of yarn, take a picture of people holding eggs, place four coconuts on top of a pole, and choose the lowest unique number of cookies.

videos.title: Marika Carlsson
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must make a jumper as long as possible, score a basket without their hands, perform a sketch in Icelandic, put something in a bathtub, predict how many words they can list for a category, make something spin for the longest, eat doughnuts without licking their lips, and sort some objects by size using their feet. Also, four of the contestants get to write their own tasks, while the fifth contestant has to guess who wrote each of them.

videos.title: Oscar Zia
videos.overview: In this season finale, the contestants must litter the garden and clean it up, write and perform a song about a stranger, transport a coconut as far as possible, conceal grapes in their mouth or hand, greet David from different countries, make a replica of an existing object, get as high as possible, and stand up after exactly 100 seconds. Also, Nassim Al Fakir gets to sing along to the Taskmaster theme tune.

videos.title: Bonus Program with Extra Tasks
videos.overview: In this bonus episode, featuring previously unaired tasks, the contestants must remove a tablecloth from underneath some eggs, hide from David, put as many clothes pins on their face as possible, give David a memorable hug, invent a new Olympic sport, record the most incredible POV footage, do something remarkable synchronised, and sneeze the fastest. Also, Nassim Al Fakir gets to have fun on a bouncy castle.

videos.title: Johan Glans guests
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must follow the clues and do what they spell, travel the furthest while making a continuous noise, lie on the ground when a siren sounds, rotate David, identify the previous guests, work out what a switch does, tie themselves up as securely as possible, and play a game of 'Sausage or Finger?'.

videos.title: Josefin Johansson guests
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must transfer some rice to the bottle, raise David's heart rate, make and converse with a ventriloquist's doll, pop a popcorn kernel, predict how many words they can list in a category, complete seven activities in a certain order, lower a balloon as far as possible, and beat on the drum after exactly 9.58 seconds.

videos.title: Peter Apelgren guests
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must move a beach ball through a slalom course using water, estimate the total of their dice rolls, score a goal from the greatest distance, order a pizza without using certain words, complete some five-syllable words, throw something over a wall and into a barrel, write a ten word story while running, and then name birds while eating grapes.

videos.title: Nassim Al Fakir guests
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must throw and catch an item, steal the world's best bun, make a moustache from something unexpected, pack all the luggage and drive it 'abroad', fish from the 'risk pond', drop a letter, move water from one tub to another, and get dressed while wearing handcuffs.

videos.title: Farah Abadi guests
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must find an Icelandic fireman, be the second fastest to high-five David, make a soap opera cliff-hanger, remove a banknote from under a glass, sing a famous song together, make the longest line of mayonnaise, get a ball in a hole in as few strokes as possible, conceal themselves inside a car, and stack plates and bowls on their head.

videos.title: Kayo Shekoni guests
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must empty a toilet roll, do something without police permission, pop a balloon, untangle some double-negatives, identify the Easter bunny, nest as many objects as possible, build a tower of cans on a pedestal, build an impressive 'lime path', and roll or throw an egg onto a target.

videos.title: Lina Hedlund guests
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must collect balloons without David seeing them, build a house out of paper, throw a sledgehammer the third longest distance, change their appearance in a lift, pair some nuts and bolts, cheer up a critic, bowl over and then set back up some items, and throw a frying pan into a hoop.

videos.title: Özz Nûjen guests
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must invite David to tea, recall the order of the deck of cards, say hello to David from as far away as possible, hold a box above a table, save a satsuma, ride a tricycle while blindfolded, create the best domino effect, and retrieve your shoe using toilet roll.

videos.title: Henrik Dorsin guests
videos.overview: In this season finale, the contestants must land a ball in a hat after three bounces, make the best noise, make and serve David a drink, select the lowest unique number of fried eggs, do the worst thing and make the best apology, stand up after 100 seconds. Also, Ankan is set the task of singing along to the Taskmaster theme tune, and four of the contestants get to write their own tasks, while the fifth contestant has to guess who wrote each of them.

videos.title: Bonus episode
videos.overview: In this bonus episode, featuring previously unaired tasks, the contestants must greet people until their ages add up to 100, roll something as far as possible, play a game of coconut bowls, herd some ping pong balls across a bridge, complete a task as one person, invent a new musical instrument, and find a Sergeant with hindsight.

videos.title: Jesper Rönndahl
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must catapult ducks into a paddling pool, create an impressive greeting, score as many goals as possible, unshackle themselves and eat a cupcake, choose what to do with three food items, make an accurate and inventive egg timer, and catch tomatoes in their chef's hat.

videos.title: Christine Meltzer
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must rescue a cat from a tree, complete as many tasks as possible, find out what's in the karate guy's box, build a sweet and salty tower, make the best quick-change outfit, shoot a sausage at something (or something at a sausage), and strike poses to represent a sport, an animal, and a colour.

videos.title: Anis Don Demina
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must fill a toilet with A4 paper, score 11 points, create an outfit for David, take care of a task brief, duel with David, make a root vegetable fall, and squirt paint while maintaining eye contact.

videos.title: Kristina "Keyyo" Petrushina
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must ingest a watermelon, inflate a balloon until it pops, step as far as possible, play a game of 'Babben says', celebrate Babben with a celebrity, throw something heavy as far as possible, and throw fruit at a target without getting in on a pizza.

videos.title: Fredrik Lindström
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must extract and read a task brief, predict the outcome of a hobby horse race, inflate and introduce their balloon buddies, cover themselves in sticky notes, make the most dramatic entrance, walk 589 steps with David, and throw an egg through a basketball hoop.

videos.title: Niklas Andersson
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must fill a cup with coffee, throw something into a pedal bin, converse with a stranger about themselves, name words beginning with 'shrimp', draw a portrait of the Taskmaster across a flipchart, play mini golf with an egg, and select the lowest unique number of jelly candies.

videos.title: Pernilla Wahlgren
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must put the most spaghetti into a grapefruit, travel as far as possible without touching the ground, break as many eggs as possible, draw their own face on a face shield, drop a water balloon as far as possible without it bursting, erect a tent while under the influence of a remote control, present the cutest dog, and put on a frozen shirt and tie.

videos.title: David Batra
videos.overview: In this episode the contestants must break an egg over David's head, light a torch, read a sign, draw the longest snake, extinguish a torch, give David a package with unexpected contents, and get the most balls onto the target.

videos.title: Nour El Refai
videos.overview: In this season finale, the contestants must get the most eggs into a frying pan, create the biggest crème fraiche explosion, travel as far as possible while blindfolded, communicate an animal to the Taskmaster using only sounds, turn on a coffee machine from a distance, catch some tennis balls, and stand up after exactly 100 seconds.

videos.title: Bonus Episode
videos.overview: In this bonus episode, featuring previously unaired tasks, the contestants must erase an eraser, point due North, raise and lower the temperature on a thermometer, move sand from one bin to another, create an attractive appetiser, put an increasing number of things between the rungs of a ladder, and bag the heaviest thing and get it to the finish line. Also, Arantxa gets to sing along with the Taskmaster theme tune.

videos.title: Danny Saucedo and Nassim Al Fakir
It just goes and goes
videos.overview: Mauri Hermundsson performs a life-threatening death jump. Maria Lundqvist sprays hairspray in her mouth and Johan Petersson finally gets to take a dip. In addition, Charlotta Björck reveals the status of her gut flora and Behrouz Badreh kisses an aunt.

videos.title: The world's most disgusting fruit
videos.overview: Maria Lundqvist transports soup in a sleeping bag, Behrouz Badreh eats far too hot chili and Johan Petersson falls out of a hammock. Charlotta Björck is exposed to the world's most smelly fruit and Mauri Hermundsson throws a ball in David's face.

videos.title: If there's tape, there's hope
videos.overview: Johan is looking for socks and Maria participates in the annual Babbenloppet. Mauri gets into a fight with a German currywurst salesman and Behrouz doesn't get along with an air rifle. In addition, Charlotta smuggles David into the club. How will this end?

videos.title: We at the news think it's sad
videos.overview: This time, Maria Lundqvist shows something she has never shown before. Behrouz Badreh spills beans on the floor and Mauri Hermundsson fills a toilet with liquid. In addition, Johan Petersson eats brunch and Charlotta Björck throws David down from the balcony.

videos.title: Hello, it's Baba Ganoush
videos.overview: Yes, Behrouz Badreh chases baba ganoush with a hammer. Charlotta Björck puts David on an egg and Johan Petersson bends the camel's back. In addition, Mauri Hermundsson gets caught in a mousetrap and Maria Lundqvist puts balloons in her nose.

videos.title: I will spear the eggplant
videos.overview: Don't miss Johan Petersson spearing an eggplant! Mauri Hermundsson eats a marmalade sandwich and Maria Lundqvist laces up her skates. In addition, Behrouz Badreh tries to be cool on order and Charlotta Björck breaks arm with David.

videos.title: Should I park a sous vide?
videos.overview: This time, Behrouz Badreh is carrying a bunch of balloons. Charlotta Björck gets to meet the Icelandic fireman and Johan Petersson is kidnapped. Mauri Hermundsson plays a high game and Maria Lundqvist completes a Swedish classic.

videos.title: The cow pushed me on to the ground
videos.overview: Anders Johansson claims that "Kossan puttade ut mig på marken" (The cow pushed me on to the ground) as his excuse for causing his team to fail so close to achieving their goal during the Bring the cow to the pool task

videos.title: Can’t go wrong with a fox
videos.overview: David Sundin answers "En räv sitter väl aldrig fel" (Can’t go wrong with a fox) after Mauri Hermundsson asks him what his own favourite animal is, during their chat before the Make the scales read exactly a given weight task.

videos.title: Gorgonzola, it's a cheese right?
videos.overview: Behrouz Badreh rhetorically asks "Gorgonzola, det är en ost va?" (Gorgonzola, it's a cheese right?) while reading the menu during the Throw the worst-tasting food into the dumpster task.

videos.title: Here comes the eye candy
videos.overview: During his attempt at the Trick or treat David task, Eric Stern enters the lab cooing the phrase "Här kommer ögongodis" (Here comes the eye candy) to unsettle David Sundin.

videos.title: Dragging for mother-in-law in the wrong lake
videos.overview: Torbjörn Averås Skorup informs David Sundin that he’ll be "Dragga efter svärmor i fel sjö" (Dragging for mother-in-law in the wrong lake) next Thursday, after finishing his attempt at the Invent new exercise equipment task. He’d been singing a song about dragging for his mother-in-law in the wrong lake during his attempt, referencing an old one-line Swedish joke, ‘Så roligt har jag inte haft sen vi draggade efter svärmor i fel sjö’ (I haven’t had this much fun since we dragged for my mother-in-law in the wrong lake).

videos.title: Oh no, I stepped in poop
videos.overview: Torbjörn Averås Skorup cries out "Åh nej, jag gick i bajs" (Oh no, I stepped in poop) while walking towards the water to retrieve the task brief in the Photograph the lake monster task.

videos.title: Troll in the wind
videos.overview: "Troll i vind" (Troll in the wind) is the title Marie Agerhall gives to her 101st ASMR sound, during her attempt at the Record a livestream highlight reel task.

videos.title: Babben is unhappy
videos.overview: David Sundin states that "Babben är missnöjd" (Babben is unhappy) with the contestants’ cakes, after the completion of the first part of the Decorate your cake / Undecorate your cake task.

videos.title: This is 100% gravy
videos.overview: Olof Wretling guesses "Det här är 100% brunsås" (This is 100% gravy) during the Free yourselves and have a team hug task.

videos.title: Shame about such rare peas
videos.overview: Eric Stern uses the expression which translates as "Väldigt synd på rara ärtor" (Shame about such rare peas) during the Place the most weight in the hammock task, while acknowledging that his attempt has gone poorly. This Swedish phrase is used to express that it’s a shame something has gone to waste.

videos.title: Twice in a lifetime
videos.overview: David Sundin muses that Torbjörn Averås Skorup’s achievement had suddenly become a "Twice in a lifetime" feat, after he immediately repeats it during the Complete a once-in-a-lifetime feat task.

videos.title: Set the bowling free!
videos.overview: Eric Stern exclaims "Släpp bowlingen fri!" (Set the bowling free!) after dropping a bowling ball off of a balcony and breaking it open during the Create a collision task.

videos.title: I think about table tennis a lot
videos.overview: Eric Stern coolly replies "Jag tänker väldigt mycket pingis" (I think about table tennis a lot) when Babben Larsson asks if he plays a lot of the sport, after his impressive attempt at the Win a point against David in table tennis task.

videos.title: You should hang from your abdomen and power hand
videos.overview: Gina Dirawi advises an awkwardly-taped David Sundin that "Du ska hänga från buken och powerhanden" (You should hang from your abdomen and power hand) in order to keep himself from falling, during her attempt at the Duct-tape David to the wall task.

videos.title: You don’t have any holes!
videos.overview: Gina Dirawi exclaims "Du har ju inga hål!" (You don’t have any holes!) to David Sundin, while searching for a hiding place – and again, later, while searching for a rubber duck – during the Hide the rubber duck / Find the rubber duck task.

videos.title: Golf is one of the coolest things there is
videos.overview: The episode title of "Golf är bland det häftigaste som finns" (Golf is one of the coolest things there is) doesn’t appear to be a quote from the broadcast edit of the episode, but is presumably something said in relation to Alfred Svensson’s attempt at the Do something cool using a green-screen suit task.

videos.title: I shaved my arms for this
videos.overview: Gina Dirawi informs David Sundin that "Jag har rakat mina armar för det här" (I shaved my arms for this) during the Get goosebumps task, indicating that he won’t be able to tell whether she has goosebumps based on raised arm hair.

videos.title: You are named Baloo today
videos.overview: Christine Meltzer tells David Sundin that "Du heter Baloo idag" (You are named Baloo today) during her attempt at the Legally distinct wooden block game task, assigning him his first new nickname as dictated by the instructions on one of the blocks.

videos.title: A cradle of toast
videos.overview: David Sundin suggests that the chocolate bunny eaten by Alfred Svensson has landed in "En vagga av toast" (A cradle of toast) in his stomach, during the Eat the chocolate bunny task.

videos.title: Aja baja, cookie tasty
videos.overview: Jan Rippe guesses that "Aja baja kaka smaka" (Aja baja, cookie tasty) was one of the things David Sundin had said to him at the start of the Surprise memory test task. “Aja baja” is a light Swedish scolding term used to, for example, remind toddlers not to touch something. The second part of what he said – “kaka smaka” – also rhymes in Swedish.

videos.title: We’ll never get to turn him on
videos.overview: Alfred Svensson mutters to himself that "Vi kommer aldrig få sätta på honom" (We’ll never get to turn him on), while his team struggles to complete the Turn on D.A.V.I.D. task. Just as in English, the phrase ‘turn on’ can be interpreted sexually in Swedish.

videos.title: High-five, possibly
videos.overview: At the end of the Delay David from reading the task brief task, David Sundin congratulates the team of Christine Meltzer, Gina Dirawi, and Olle Sarri with the words "Bra jobbat, eventuellt" (Good job, possibly). Olle then high-fives his team-mates in celebration and – mocking David – says "High five, eventuellt" (High-five, possibly).

videos.title: Linköping
videos.overview: Alfred Svensson offers Linköping as the name of a city that is not a capital, during the [Questions and lies) task.

videos.title: That's how the frisbee goes!
videos.overview: Season start. Victor Beer is dancing, Daniel Nannskog is teaching football tactics to a child and Kirsty Armstrong serves orangesoup to David. Peter Magnusson is throwing frisbees and Jenny Strömstedt tests another participant

videos.title: Husse Husse Husse Husse Husse Hussein
videos.overview: Nannskog inflates ballons, Victor rolls the dice and Peter tries to score a goal wearing too many trousers. Kirsty eats raw onion, Jenny becomes a musician and Alfred visits the studio for a game of "office chairs"

videos.title: You’ve got time for a number two in three and a half minutes
There’s a lasagna in number seven
videos.overview: Peter struggles to understand what Babben is saying, Jenny shakes hands with lasagna and Victor pays tribute to Mats Sundin. Also, Kirsty plays watering can and Nannskog does tricks with a ball.

videos.title: The 100th episode of Bäst i Test
videos.overview: In the 100th episode of Best in Test, Kirsty tries to blow out 100 cake candles, Nannskog throws balls and Victor launches himself with a rocket. Peter swings the baguette and Jenny tries to win a pub quiz.

videos.title: Who the hell cares about vinegar?
videos.overview: In this thrilling episode, Jenny tries to guess Babben's opinions, Peter makes his debut as a TV chef and Nannskog immediately regrets it. Also, Kirsty tries to count to seven and Victor buryes a time capsule.

videos.title: Viscosity
videos.overview: Victor makes an egg track, Jenny's favorite word is bumblebee and Kirsty looks for potatoes with a seagull. Also, David shoots an arrow at Nannskog and Peter tries to catch a hot dog on the run.

videos.title: 5 fresh into the account
videos.overview: Nannskog receives electric shocks and Jenny tries to attach a radio to the wall. Victor dresses up as a goat, Peter sings a song, and Kirsty tries to shoot sunscreen.

videos.title: It's the pee you want
videos.overview: Tonight, Victor fills the house with smoke, Kirsty eats raw potatoes and Peter shares a childhood memory. Jenny goes on a rampage when she is looking for a grape and Nannskog is shooting a western movie.

videos.title: Wondering if Babben Likes Me
videos.overview: Time for the finale where Jenny makes ten incredible desserts, Victor cycles into a tree and Nannskog shows a party trick. Also, Peter lies and Kirsty tries to steal as much as she can from the test house.

videos.title: I Dreamt Last Night That You Were Wearing a Strange Hat
videos.overview: Will Lasse Kronér manage to surprise himself? Can Ahmed Berhan get a hole in one? We also get to see Carina Berg lazing in a deck chair, David Druid designing new clothes and Emma Molin making a suspicious call.

videos.title: Sport Is Not My Best Subject
videos.overview: In tonight's episode, Lasse Kronér tries to make the world a better place, Emma Molin imitates a shellfish and Carina Berg insults David Sundin. In addition, it rains balls on David Druid and Ahmed Berhan loses his shirt.

videos.title: Off with the Mask!
videos.overview: An episode where Carina Berg tries to make her mother swear, Lasse Kronér takes a walk with a cow and Ahmed Berhan sails across the Atlantic. In addition, Emma Molin raises a flag and David Druid puts on a suit backwards.

videos.title: You Have the Strangest Voice I've Ever Heard
videos.overview: Now you! Emma Molin tries to fit into a bathtub while David Druid hides in a closet. In addition, Carina Berg sets fire to a finger, Lasse Kronér gets confused and Ahmed Berhan misunderstands the rules.

videos.title: Yo Yo Rapping Rapping
videos.overview: The participants are tasked with upgrading David Sundin - will it be Carina's dance lesson or Ahmed's makeover that wins the battle? In addition, Emma gets to eat marmalade balls, Lasse arranges a christening and David puts the carrot in a bucket.

videos.title: What Was It I Said?
videos.overview: Carina Berg offers free massages, Emma Molin smashes a cake into David Sundin’s backside, and Ahmed Berhan sings a song. Meanwhile, Lasse Kronér tries to hear what Babben Larsson is saying, and David Druid attempts to remember what it was he said.

videos.title: What Kind of Bird Is Woody Woodpecker?
videos.overview: The Karate Old Man returns to Best in Test to properly put our contestants Emma Molin, Lasse Kronér, Carina Berg, David Druid and Ahmed Berhan through their paces. Everything goes perfectly and exactly as expected.

videos.title: Go for a Thousand
videos.overview: Will Lasse Kronér manage to find something he himself has hidden in tonight’s episode of Best in Test? David Druid goes to a restaurant, Emma Molin eats yoghurt in her underwear, and Carina Berg embarrasses herself. Meanwhile, Ahmed Berhan attempts to trick Babben Larsson.

videos.title: Rotten Eggs Don't Smell Very Good
videos.overview: Ahmed Berhan sends a ball into the lake, and Carina Berg throws a frisbee while Lasse Kronér and Emma Molin hide David Druid as best they can.

videos.title: Gunilla Vestman
videos.overview: It’s the season finale, and that means it’s time to find out who gets to lift Babben’s bust. Will it be David Druid, Emma Molin, Ahmed Berhan, Carina Berg, or perhaps even Lasse Kronér?
